claim: `command/pages` holds no page of its own and 29 subfolders, and those are exactly the 29 pages `command/command.page-type.ts` declares as parts: 3 `command` folders and 26 `namespace` folders. `pages-of-the-type-above` admits it: a subfolder is admitted for holding one page of the type above or one page that type declares a part, and each of the 29 is admitted one way or the other. The audit round at `1caacb64e06` refuses no folder under `commands`. No change agent writes this layout. The root `command/pages` is read by `command-is-named-by-its-place-in-the-tree`, which walks the command tree from it, and is stated by two more checks and two syntax rules in their decisions, so moving the 26 namespace trees under `command/namespace/pages/` or dissolving `command/pages` into `command/` would each change those checks as well as the folder. Neither is owed: nothing refuses the folder as it is.

evidence:
Read 2026-09-13 at `de8ba944eec`, without running the audit.

What the folder holds. `command/pages` holds no file of its own and 29 tracked subfolders: `audit`, `deploy` and `read` hold one `*.command.ts` each, and the other 26 hold one `*.namespace.ts` each. `command/command.page-type.ts:11-13` declares `command/audit`, `command/deploy` and `command/read`, and `:78-103` declares 26 `namespace/...` parts; the two sets match name for name, so nothing there is undeclared and nothing declared lacks a folder. No empty untracked folder sits beside them: `find -empty` finds none.

Why the shape admits it. `pages-of-the-type-above.folder-shape.code.ts:53-55` keeps as loose only a subfolder that holds neither one page of the type above nor one page that type declares a part, and `:57-59` refuses on those alone. The type above is `command`, the one page type in `command/`. The 3 command folders each hold one page of `command`. The 26 namespace folders hold no `command` — `command/namespace/namespace.page-type.ts:9` extends `page-type/domain` — and are admitted by the second test, since each `namespace/...` is among the parts above. The folder's own pages, properties and strays are all empty, so no other branch of the shape fires. The audit round at `1caacb64e06`, kept in the seats' audit-refusals files, lists 88 `folder-matches-a-shape` refusals and none under `commands`; between that commit and `de8ba944eec` the only changes under `command/` are six code bodies, with no folder added or taken away.

What writes it. No change agent: `change/agent/folder/` holds `move-folder`, `move-folder-package`, `nest-modules`, `remove-folder` and `remove-folder-package`, and `git grep nest-commands` finds nothing outside `domain/finding`.

What reads the root. `command-is-named-by-its-place-in-the-tree.check-code.decision.code.ts:15` sets `PAGES_AT` to `command/pages`, walks the tree from it at `:220`, and at `:283` requires every page the `command` page type names to sit in a folder directly under it; its page states the path in eight decisions (`:36`, `:53`, `:76`, `:90`, `:94`, `:99`, `:112`, `:117`). `command-takes-its-arguments-through-one-reader.check-code.ts:74,82`, `command-taking-two-words-is-tested-from-words.check-code.ts:42`, `command-export-named-for-its-slug.syntax-rule.ts:29` and `no-command-spelling-its-own-call.syntax-rule.ts:15,47` state it too, and three test files build fixture paths on it: `command-taking-two-words-is-tested-from-words.check-code.decision.test.ts:70`, `measure-command.command.test.ts:90` and `command-measuring.module.test.ts:34-72`. Either folder edit moves pages out from under `PAGES_AT`, which `:283` refuses.

Two folder edits are open and neither is owed. Moving the 26 namespace trees to `command/namespace/pages/`: the `namespace` page type sits at `command/namespace/namespace.page-type.ts` with `pluralSlug` `namespaces` (`:8`), so `pages-of-the-type-above` would read that folder too. Dissolving `command/pages` into `command/`: all 29 are declared parts. Each also edits the checks above.
